authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.observation: EED items 40–42 map to DXF groups 1040–1042 and contain eight-byte real values; the specification defaults to little-endian data.

construction: LibreDWG 0.14 generates locally authored R13/R14 controls with 1.25, -0.5 and 42.125, remapped root, APPID and group handles, and one 3D LINE member. LibreDWG JSON readback verifies the values and source graph. No generated drawing is committed.
checks: The shared source observer compares each finite typed double to its exact 64-bit little-endian source representation.

ASan controls exercise all three codes, per-bit source mutations, truncations, changed typed values, and a NaN whose source bytes and model agree; malformed or changed state is refused and corrected retry succeeds.

Group, NOD and MLINESTYLE owner profiles pass R14 strict and R13 explicit-partial ASCII/Binary output. A balanced 1002 group remains outside this profile and preserves its prior explicit-partial route.
Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 readback recovers all three values and a separate GROUP-to-3D-LINE edge for each location and source version.
limits: Non-finite source values are not admitted by this profile.
R13 output remains explicit partial; MLINESTYLE source semantics, native cloning and general DWG/DXF support remain unqualified. Other EED codes and source graphs remain open.
